translationRepairs: Both men were afraid. That night they climbed the wall to encourage the rampart guards, and in the moonlight plotted their next move. Wang Jian said to Han Jian, "His sweet talk and lavish favors mean he suspects us. Disaster cannot be far off—we should choose our advantage and move while we can."

Both men were afraid. That night they climbed the wall to encourage the rampart guards, and in the moonlight plotted their next move. Wang Jian said to Han Jian, "The Vice Director's sweet talk and lavish favors mean he suspects us. Disaster cannot be far off—we should choose our advantage and move while we can."
The spoken line addresses Lu Yanhong as 僕射, not with a pronoun. Reducing that office to 'His' omits the title used in the quote, even though s0010 already makes the feigned favors his.
Within ten days Wang Jian mustered all the troops Gu Yanlang could spare, raised siege ladders and rams, and assaulted Chengdu. After three days he failed and withdrew, again holding Hanzhou.
Within ten days Wang Jian mustered all the Dongchuan forces, raised siege ladders and rams, and assaulted Chengdu. After three days he failed and withdrew, again holding Hanzhou.
The sentence says Jian took all the forces of Dongchuan (東川之眾). It does not name Gu Yanlang; inserting him invents an agent this unit does not state.

Chen Jingxuan refused to step down. The emperor was furious and ordered Gu Yanlang and Yang Shouliang to attack him. Wei Zhaodu meanwhile made Wang Jian commander of the palace guard and put him in charge of his own troops.

Chen Jingxuan refused to step down. The emperor was furious and ordered Gu Yanlang and Yang Shouliang to attack him. Wei Zhaodu meanwhile made Wang Jian commander of the headquarters troops and put him in charge of his own troops.
牙內都校 is a governor-headquarters command, not a palace-guard post. 'Commander of the headquarters troops' corrects that error without changing the rest of the sentence.

Jingxuan would not accept replacement; the Son of Heaven was angry and ordered Gu Yanlang and Yang Shouliang to attack him; at the time Zhaodu made Jian commander of the palace guard and supervised his division troops.

Jingxuan would not accept replacement; the Son of Heaven was angry and ordered Gu Yanlang and Yang Shouliang to attack him; at the time Zhaodu made Jian inner yamen commander and supervised his division troops.
The same 牙內都校 is mistranslated as palace guard in the literal. 'Inner yamen commander' matches the office name and the following 董其部兵.

Same annotation leak in the literal: keep the English ") that closes the Shu Annals quotation, and drop only 〉.
When Zhao Kuangning lost Jing and Xiang, his younger brother Kuangming fled to Shu with his staff; Jian thereby gained Qí, Xiá, Zhōng, Wàn, and other prefectures.
When Zhao Kuangning lost Jing and Xiang, his younger brother Kuangming fled to Shu with his staff; Jian thereby gained Kui, Xia, Zhong, Wan, and other prefectures.
夔 is Kui, not Qí. 峽、忠、萬 are Xia, Zhong, and Wan, matching the idiomatic Kuizhou, Xiazhou, Zhongzhou, and Wanzhou.
When Yan came to Shu, Guangsi and others gave a private banquet and spoke of recent affairs in the central realm; Yan also cited recent events to refute them—the account is in Yan's biography.

When Li Yan came to Shu, Guangsi and others gave a private banquet and spoke of recent affairs in the central realm; Li Yan also cited recent events to refute them—the account is in Li Yan's biography.
Each 嚴 in this unit is the envoy Li Yan (李嚴), including 語在嚴傳. Bare 'Yan' collides with Wang Yan 衍 in the surrounding narrative.
Southern forces will march from Jiangling, advancing when the advantage is ours and falling back to hold Xiakou if not.
Southern forces will march from Jiangling, advancing when the advantage is ours and falling back to hold the gorge mouth if not.
硤口 is the mouth of the gorges (峽/硤), a fallback west of Jiangling toward Shu, not the Yangzi city 夏口 (Xiakou).

I am filled with fear and trembling before Your Majesty, who inherits the legacy of Yao and Shun, marshals armies like those of the Shang founders, pacifies the realm, destroys the wicked, gathers tribute from every quarter, and unifies the empire under one order.

I am filled with fear and trembling before Your Majesty, who inherits the legacy of Yao and Shun, marshals armies like those of Tang and Wu, pacifies the realm, destroys the wicked, gathers tribute from every quarter, and unifies the empire under one order.
湯、武 names Tang of Shang and King Wu of Zhou as paired martial exemplars. 'Shang founders' drops Wu and misassigns him to Shang.

When Wang Jian declared himself emperor, Hanlin academicians received the greatest favor. Some courtiers said his courtesies went too far. Wang Jian replied, "You simply have not seen how it was done before.

When Wang Jian declared himself emperor, only the Hanlin academicians received the greatest favor. Some courtiers said his courtesies went too far. Wang Jian replied, "You simply have not seen how it was done before.
惟 restricts the exceptional favor to the Hanlin academicians. Omitting 'only' lets the sentence mean they merely ranked high among others so favored.
When Meng Zhixiang took command of Shu, Chang and his mother entered Shu together with his wife, the Eldest Princess of Qionghua.
When Meng Zhixiang took command of Shu, Chang and his mother entered Shu together with Zhixiang's wife, the Eldest Princess of Qionghua.
知祥妻 is Meng Zhixiang's wife, the Eldest Princess of Qionghua. After naming Chang, 'his wife' wrongly makes her Chang's spouse.
